journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: A quarter (1/4) means one out of four equal parts. If you cut a pizza into 4 equal slices, each slice is 1/4.
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about identifying 1/4 in everyday objects. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
